crossRefs.note: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake…
“Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel…
For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.
“We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of…
Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear…
Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again…
As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you…
Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

translations.web: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
translations.bsb: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
translations.kjv: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
translations.asv: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud. Psalm 124 A Song of Ascents; of David.
